svg.title: Achievements
svg.desc: HackNova — Winner (SRM Easwari College, MAR 2026): Built an ML-driven organ compatibility matching system that pairs donors and recipients in real time for hospitals.; Nexathon — Runner-up (Vel Tech Multi Tech College, FEB 2026): A student finance planner that predicts savings, budgets and goal timelines with interactive projections.; Patent Published (Indian Patent Journal No. 20/2026, MAY 2026): Solar Panel Efficiency Optimization System for rural use; engineered and benchmarked 7 ML models for performance prediction.; Abacus Grandmaster (SIP Abacus · Certified, 2021): Certified Grandmaster in abacus mental arithmetic.
